build_CBoW_embedding: build a CBoW module that embeds token sequences and sums embeddings across the sequence dimension
create_MASC_convolution: create a MASC module that applies attention-weighted 3x3 convolution based on action output logits
create_NoMASC_convolution: create a NoMASC module that applies fixed cross-shaped 3x3 convolution mask to input tensors
build_ControlStep_attention: build a ControlStep module that extracts messages via attention hop and updates control embeddings
create_GRUEncoder_sequence: create a GRUEncoder module that encodes variable-length sequences with optional CBoW embedding into hidden states
